# Top Threadz

> Top Threadz is a Pakistani multi-category men's fashion retailer selling premium unstitched wash & wear fabric, stitched menswear, two-piece and three-piece suits, and kids' clothing — with nationwide Cash on Delivery delivery and a flagship store in Zamzama, DHA Phase 5, Karachi.

Top Threadz (topthreadz.com.pk) is an e-commerce menswear brand founded in Karachi, Pakistan. The company is known for its signature wrinkle-resistant wash & wear unstitched fabric sold by the suit length, and has expanded into a full menswear range: stitched garments, coordinated two-piece and three-piece ensembles, waistcoats, and a kids' line. Every product is described with its fabric composition, care instructions, and available sizes. Customers pay via Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, or online payment, with free nationwide shipping on orders over PKR 10,000 and a 7-day exchange window on unaltered items.

## Essential Facts

- Brand: Top Threadz
- Founded in: Karachi, Pakistan
- Flagship store: Zamzama Commercial Area, DHA Phase 5, Karachi (Mon–Sat 11:00–22:30, Sun 14:00–22:00)
- Phone: +92 300 9070520
- Email: support@topthreadz.pk
- Price range: PKR 2,500 – PKR 15,000
- Currency: PKR (Pakistani Rupee)
- Payment methods: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, online payment
- Delivery: Nationwide across Pakistan, 2–5 working days typical
- Free shipping: Orders above PKR 10,000
- Returns: 7-day exchange window for unused, unaltered items with tags
- Primary categories: Unstitched, Stitched, Two Piece, Three Piece, Kids

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does Top Threadz sell?** A multi-category menswear range — unstitched wash & wear fabric, stitched garments, two and three-piece suits, waistcoats, and kids' wear.

**How long does delivery take?** 2–5 working days across Pakistan, depending on location and courier availability.

**Is Cash on Delivery available?** Yes, COD is available for eligible orders nationwide; online payment options are also offered.

**Can I return a product?** Yes — within 7 days of delivery, provided the item is unused, unwashed, unaltered, and retains its tags and packaging.

**Is the fabric wrinkle-free?** The signature wash & wear line is woven to resist wrinkles; product-specific fabric details are listed on each product page.
